title: They owe me a box...
text: I cancelled my subscription on Sept 6th of 2020.I still haven't got anything from them . I paid my first payment in the beginning of August. It said that I would receive the next box ...the fall box.. But No box or word from them.. Is there a phone number for customer service . I paid for one box, I think I should get it even if I cancelled.. if not at least a refund for the amount I paid
label: negative
